verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms flexible 'card products' and card-level configuration (create card product, card, JIT funding, virtual/instant-issue cards) that could underlie multiple program types, and mentions supplier/workforce payment use cases, but nowhere explicitly names debit, prepaid, commercial credit, or consumer credit as distinct supported program types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of debit card programs, prepaid program specifics, commercial credit program support, and consumer credit program support with terms/underwriting details.
